activeMigrations.change: Removed non-image insertion controls are replaced by explicit Commands fixture setup. Current properties, real selection, geometry, movement, undo/redo, protection, author layouts and actual download/reopen assertions remain active. Fixture construction is NOT proof of a supported insertion UI. No-space non-image cases assert the actual Commands rejection; no synthetic error UI.
Download selectors now use real edit/save-status/explicit download clicks; no forced clicks or internal serialization substitute.
Image chooser uses direct 插入图片 button; decode, crop, history and round-trip assertions remain active.

Runtime inclusion contract intentionally changes from html-print present to absent; requires editor/player and rejects insert-menu/version-panel. PDF button must be top-level and disabled pending F04A/F04.
